text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day has arrived for the Prix Foy, a 
GII race for Senior-class Umamusume held 
at the ParisLongchamp Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beyond this preliminary race, the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe awaits, with the top of 
the world on the line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The prelude to the battle for the title of 
world number one: the Prix Foy begins...!
